SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY S. B. D. 2998 Section 2. Station, u/c 23 H 31. Date November 23, 1931）
Subject (in full) Tai Van Chon (戴萬昌) c/o Sue Mo (水沫) Publishing Company,
V.1109 North Szechuen Road.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by （签名）
The Sue Mo (水沫) Publishing Co., which was formerly
located at No.V.1109 Kung Yih Faung (公益坊) off North Szechuen
Road, suspended business in March 1931. The premises are at
present occupied by the Tung Hwa (東華) Book store.
Exhaustive enquiries have failed to establish the
identity of one Tai Van Chon (戴萬昌), the addressee mentioned
on the wrapper. The ex-manager of the Sue Mo Publishing Co.
was one Tai Yoong Sue (戴鳳書) who left Shanghai for Hangchow
immediately after the closing down of the company. The exact
address of Tai at Hangchow is unknown nor can any information
regarding his present occupation be secured.
A copy of the wrapper has been made for reference.
Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
S2,
Please return the wrapper
to the Chaplain, Police Commissariat.
The messenger should hand the
wrapper to the Chaplain personally.
（签名）
23.11.31
Wrapper returned to Postal Authorities 28/11/31
SSR. 307" J. Leggett 30.11.31. W.B. Moore （签名）

呈报人：督察 顾宝华 (Kuh Pao-hwa)。转发人 （签名）
水沫 (Sue Mo) 出版公司原址位于北四川路旁公益坊 (Kung Yih Faung) V.1109号，于1931年3月停业。该址现由东华 (Tung Hwa) 书店占用。
经详尽查询，未能查明信封上所列收件人戴萬昌 (Tai Van Chon) 的身份。水沫出版公司前经理为戴鳳書 (Tai Yoong Sue)，该公司关闭后随即离开上海前往杭州。戴在杭州的确切地址不详，亦无法获取有关其目前职业的任何信息。
已复印信封一份以备查考。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
& S. D. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 2998.
Date 5-12-31.）

December 5 2.

My dear Steptoe,

I send you herewith a copy of the
"Young Guard", an English language propaganda
journal. It is known that copies of the
"Young Guard" find their way to Shanghai from
time to time.

Yours sincerely,

E. H. Steptoe, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.

S. B. D. 2998。
日期 31-12-5。）

12月5日 2.

亲爱的 Steptoe，

兹随函附上英文版宣传刊物
《青年近卫军》副本一份。据悉，《青年近卫军》
的副本不时流入上海。

此致
敬礼，

E. H. Steptoe 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆。

AMERICAN CONSULAR SERVICE
American Consulate General,
Shanghai, China, December 3, 1931.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. D. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2898
cte 5. 11. 4.

My dear Givens:

The receipt is acknowledged of your letter of
November 24, 1931, enclosing a communist publica-
tion entitled "Young Guard," which you state is
being circulated in Shanghai. I have read this
with considerable interest and in compliance with
1/ your request I now return the copy herewith.

Very sincerely yours,

P. R. Josselyn.

Enclosure:
1/- "Young Guard."

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
C. & S. D. 登记处
编号 S. B. D. 2898
cte 5. 11. 4.

亲爱的 Givens：

你方1931年11月24日来信收悉，信中附有一份题为《青年近卫军》的共产主义出版物，并称该刊物正在上海流传。我已饶有兴致地阅读了该刊物，并应你方要求，现将该副本随函退回。

此致
敬礼，

P. R. Josselyn.

附件：
1/- 《青年近卫军》。

T. P. Givens 先生，
副警务处长，
上海工部局，
上海。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
Vo. S. B. D. 2176
ate 24. 11. X.

November 24 1.

Dear Jocelyn,

I am sending herewith for your perusal
a Communist known publication called "The Young
Guard"* which is being circulated in Shanghai.
I shall be thankful if you will kindly return
this booklet to me after you have perused it.

Yours sincerely,

Paul L. Jocelyn, Esqre
American Consul-General.

* 8rd. 1. W.P.
24/XI X.

11月24日 1.

亲爱的 Jocelyn，

兹送上一份在上海流传的、众所周知的共产主义刊物《青年近卫军》*，供你审阅。如蒙阅后将该小册子退还本人，不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，

Paul L. Jocelyn 先生
美国总领事。

* 8rd. 1. W.P.
24/XI X.
